empty.title: Stock appears when your first purchase arrives
empty.text: Each flavour then gets a card with what's available, reserved and how long it will last.

noCount: No stock count yet this month. The warehouse counts from their phone (Stock count tab) without seeing these numbers.
noCountPhone: No stock count yet this month. The warehouse counts from their phone without seeing these numbers.

status.months: {n, plural, one {# month left} other {# months left}}

card.nowHint: Runs out before a new purchase could arrive.

allocate.title: Allocate stock
allocate.locked: Allocate · {n, plural, one {# order} other {# orders}} waiting for {number}
allocate.lockedNone: Allocate · {n, plural, one {# order} other {# orders}} waiting for stock
allocate.lockedWhy: Opens when {number} is received or stock is freed
allocate.lockedWhyNone: Opens when a purchase is received or stock is freed
allocate.intro: Suggested order: paid orders first, then the oldest. Each order gets all its cartons, so nothing ships half-filled.
allocate.short: Not enough {flavours} for every ticked order. Untick one to continue.
allocate.consequence: After allocating, paid orders become Ready to send to the warehouse. Unpaid ones hold their stock for {days} days. The agent is told either way.
allocate.cta: {n, plural, =0 {Allocate} one {Allocate to # order} other {Allocate to # orders}}
allocate.done: {n, plural, =0 {Nothing allocated} one {# order allocated. Its agent is told.} other {# orders allocated. Their agents are told.}}
allocate.emptyText: Every paid order has its stock.

adjust.title: Stock adjustment
adjust.sub: For breakage, samples or count differences.

reasonHelp.samples: Given away for tastings or events

movements.title: Stock movements
movements.kicker: Every change to stock, newest first
movements.emptyText: Receipts, shipments, returns and adjustments show here, newest first.

counts.title: Count of {date}
counts.help: The warehouse counts blind. Each count shows here with what the system expected, so you can correct the difference.
counts.banner: {n, plural, one {# stock count from the warehouse needs a check.} other {# stock counts from the warehouse need a check.}}
counts.differences: {n, plural, one {# flavour differs} other {# flavours differ}}
counts.matchesText: The count matches what the system expected. Nothing will change.
counts.correctConsequence: Creates one stock adjustment per flavour for the difference, reason Count difference, and marks the count as checked.
counts.doneAdjusted: {n, plural, one {Stock corrected for # flavour} other {Stock corrected for # flavours}}
counts.emptyText: Counts sent from the warehouse show here for checking.
counts.kicker: The warehouse counts blind; check each count here
